subject: Proof package: admin action telemetry — scope, TTL, and retrieval SLA
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <compliance@auroramed.com>, procurement@auroramed.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proof package: admin action telemetry — scope, TTL, and retrieval SLA

Hi Elena / AuroraMed team,

Thanks for the SOC 2 evidence request. To make sure we deliver exactly what you need, below are the export and retention options we can provide for admin activity / operator telemetry. Please confirm the time window and any PII redaction or hashing requirements.

Quick options (high-level):
- Full monthly snapshot (Parquet + JSONL) — includes operator_id, action_type, resource, timestamp (UTC), request_id, outcome, client_ip (can be salted/hashed)
- Daily incremental deltas (append-only) with signed SHA256 manifest per shard
- On-demand historical export (up to 24 months) — subject to sampling/retention policy & export SLA
- Live streaming to your S3 via presigned, or secure SFTP delivery for attestations

Retention/TTL presets we typically offer: 90 days (default), 13 months (SOC-2 typical), configurable up to 24 months for contract customers. We can apply per-tenant redaction rules (PII masking) during export.

Attachments: retention_matrix_v1.xlsx (matrix with field-level retention and redaction flags)

Next steps: please confirm
1) exact time window needed (e.g., last 12 months)
2) whether you require hashed user identifiers or full user ids in the export
3) preferred delivery method (S3 / SFTP / signed HTTP) and encryption key options (we support KMS/HSM wrap)

Happy to set a technical call this week to walk through sample manifests.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

---

From: Elena Park <compliance@auroramed.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@auroramed.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 12:34:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proof package: admin action telemetry — scope, TTL, and retrieval SLA

Thanks Rafael — good summary. A few clarifications from our side:  
- Time window: 12 months (we'll request a one-off 24-month lookback if needed for a specific investigation).  
- Identifiers: we need operator IDs, but must be reversible only by AuroraMed (so hashed on your side with a salt we provide, or you can deliver hashed + a separate attested mapping; reversible mappings require an additional attestation).  
- PII: please redact full client_ip unless you can provide a privacy-safe truncated version (first two octets masked).  
- Delivery: S3 transfer preferred (we will provide an S3 ingestion role and cross-account bucket).  

Attached: AuroraMed_Audit_Reqs.pdf (one-page list of required fields and regulatory notes).

We'd like the signed manifest (SHA256) per-file and a manifest-level signature/cert that ties to the delivery timestamp. Also need timezone normalization to UTC for all timestamps.

Can you confirm whether you provide Parquet schema and an example JSONL row ahead of the test transfer?

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Compliance, AuroraMed
compliance@auroramed.com

Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proof package: admin action telemetry — scope, TTL, and retrieval SLA

Elena — thanks for the clear answers. Confirming how we'll proceed and giving concrete export options so procurement can sign off:  

Export flavors we propose (pick one):
1) Monthly full snapshot + daily deltas (recommended)
   - Format: Parquet primary with companion JSONL per-record for quick lookups
   - Fields: operator_id (SHA256 with Aurora-provided salt, reversible only by Aurora), action_type, resource_path, timestamp_utc, request_id, success_bool, truncated_client_ip, region
   - Delivery: cross-account S3 with server-side encryption using KMS customer master key (you supply role)
   - Manifests: per-batch SHA256 manifest + manifest signature (we can sign with Redwood cert and provide cert chain)

2) On-demand 1-off snapshot (for investigations)
   - We can produce full 24-month export within SLA (48 hours for paid entitlements)

Other details:
- Timezone normalization: all timestamps will be delivered in UTC and include original tz-offset metadata where available.
- Retention: we'll retain 13 months by default; we can set 24 months for your tenant under a short addendum.
- Schema: attached is export_options_summary.pdf and a sample JSONL row in the Drive link.

Tech test: we can run a dry-run next Wed (2028-06-14) to push a 1GB sample and validate manifests. Please confirm a 2-hour window.

I'll coordinate with Ben on manifest field mapping and delivery handshake.

Thanks,
Rafael
